confidence_notes: The RBA rate comes from a search of the RBA exchange-rate page, with the latest observation dated 2026-11-18. Beer, inexpensive meal and mid-range meal anchors come from Numbeo-style aggregates (R$15, R$45 and R$235), with Expatistan showing a similar beer price. The conversion to USD used roughly R$5.1 per USD, taken from an Expatistan R$30 = $5.91 conversion. Coffee was not found in the searches and is estimated at about R$10. Cocktail is based on Expatistan's R$30 club cocktail, adjusted slightly upward for restaurant venues. Wine by the glass is estimated from its usual ratio to beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates only, with no live listings checked, and they vary widely by season and beach area.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared against other Brazilian southern and coastal tourist cities. Florianópolis restaurant prices run above the Brazilian average because of tourism demand.
